# GoodSync

> GoodSync is file synchronization and backup software from Siber Systems, Inc., designed for individuals, businesses, servers, NAS devices, and cloud storage.

GoodSync provides automated file backup and synchronization across computers, mobile devices, servers, NAS devices, removable storage, and cloud services. Jobs can be configured for one-way or two-way operation, with automated, scheduled, real-time, and unattended options. GoodSync supports Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, and major NAS platforms. It was released in 2006 by Siber Systems, a privately held software company headquartered in Fairfax, Virginia, USA.

Key facts:
- Configurable one-way and two-way jobs for backup and synchronization, with automated, scheduled, real-time, and unattended operation.
- Supports local storage, network shares, FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, Amazon S3, Dropbox, Box, Backblaze B2, Microsoft Azure, and other cloud services.
- GoodSync Connect provides direct peer-to-peer file transfer between computers, servers, NAS devices, and mobile devices without requiring intermediate cloud storage.
- Security features include AES-256 encryption for data in transit and at rest, SSL-secured communication, file version history, and block-level data transfer.
- Business products include GoodSync for Server OS and the web-based GoodSync Control Center for centrally deploying, configuring, and monitoring backup and synchronization jobs.
- Localized pages are available under language prefixes including /de, /es, /fr, /it, /jp, /nl, /ru, /cn, /zh, /br, and /ar.

## Product

- [GoodSync Home](https://www.goodsync.com/): Overview of GoodSync file synchronization and backup software for personal and business use.
- [Features](https://www.goodsync.com/features): Backup, synchronization, automation, security, supported protocols, and cloud-service features.
- [Personal](https://www.goodsync.com/personal): Backup, synchronization, remote access, and cloud connectivity for personal files and devices.
- [Business](https://www.goodsync.com/business): Data protection, synchronization, server backup, and centralized management for organizations.
- [File Backup Software](https://www.goodsync.com/backup-software): Automated backup and recovery across computers, servers, NAS devices, external storage, and cloud services.
- [File Synchronization Software](https://www.goodsync.com/file-sync): Automated one-way and two-way synchronization across local, network, mobile, and cloud storage.
- [Free vs. Pro](https://www.goodsync.com/free-vs-pro): Comparison of GoodSync Free and paid product capabilities.
- [Download](https://www.goodsync.com/download): GoodSync installers for supported desktop, server, mobile, Linux, and NAS platforms.

## Connectivity and Remote Access

- [GoodSync Connect](https://www.goodsync.com/goodsync-connect): Direct peer-to-peer file access, backup, and synchronization between registered devices.
- [GoodSync Explorer](https://www.goodsync.com/goodsync-explorer): Browse and access files stored across computers, servers, mobile devices, and cloud accounts.
- [Platforms and Services](https://www.goodsync.com/platforms): Supported operating systems, devices, storage systems, protocols, and cloud services.

## Business

- [GoodSync for Server OS](https://www.goodsync.com/business-server): Automated and unattended backup and synchronization for Windows and Linux servers.
- [GoodSync Control Center](https://www.goodsync.com/business-control-center): Centralized web-based deployment, job configuration, monitoring, reporting, and management.
- [Compare Business Solutions](https://www.goodsync.com/business-compare): Comparison of GoodSync workstation, server, and Control Center solutions.
- [Server Backup](https://www.goodsync.com/business-servers-backup): Backup options for servers, workstations, databases, and remote systems.
- [Server Synchronization](https://www.goodsync.com/business-servers-sync): Real-time and scheduled synchronization between business systems.
- [Server Replication](https://www.goodsync.com/business-server-replication): Automated replication for business continuity and data redundancy.
- [Business Resources](https://www.goodsync.com/business-resources): Case studies, white papers, deployment resources, and security articles.
- [Business Contact](https://www.goodsync.com/business-contact-us): Contact GoodSync about business and enterprise requirements.

## Support and Documentation

- [Support](https://www.goodsync.com/support): Product support options and links to GoodSync documentation.
- [Help Center](https://www.goodsync.com/help): Searchable GoodSync knowledge base, setup instructions, and troubleshooting articles.
- [Reference Manual](https://www.goodsync.com/manual): Detailed GoodSync configuration and operation reference.
- [Tutorial](https://www.goodsync.com/tutorial): Step-by-step instructions for creating and running GoodSync jobs.
- [FAQ](https://www.goodsync.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about GoodSync.
- [Licensing FAQ](https://www.goodsync.com/faq-licensing): GoodSync licensing, activation, and account questions.
- [GoodSync Connect Manual](https://www.goodsync.com/goodsync-connect-manual): Configuration and operation guide for GoodSync Connect.
- [Control Center Manual](https://www.goodsync.com/goodsync-control-center-manual): Administration guide for GoodSync Control Center.

## Release Notes

- [Windows](https://www.goodsync.com/news-windows): GoodSync for Windows version history.
- [Mac](https://www.goodsync.com/news-mac): GoodSync for macOS version history.
- [NAS and Linux](https://www.goodsync.com/news-nas-linux): GoodSync for NAS and Linux version history.
- [iOS](https://www.goodsync.com/news-ios): GoodSync for iPhone and iPad version history.
- [Android](https://www.goodsync.com/news-android): GoodSync for Android version history.
- [Control Center](https://www.goodsync.com/news-control-center): GoodSync Control Center version history.

## Company

- [About Us](https://www.goodsync.com/about-us): Siber Systems company history and information about GoodSync.
- [Press](https://www.goodsync.com/press): GoodSync press coverage and company announcements.
- [Office Locations](https://www.goodsync.com/locations): Global Siber Systems office locations and contact information.
- [Blog](https://www.goodsync.com/blog): GoodSync product news, backup guidance, synchronization articles, and data-security information.

## Partners and Programs

- [Affiliates](https://www.goodsync.com/affiliates): GoodSync affiliate program information.
- [Resellers](https://www.goodsync.com/resellers): GoodSync reseller program, discounts, sales resources, and partner support.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.goodsync.com/privacy-policy): How GoodSync and Siber Systems collect, use, and protect information.
- [License Agreement](https://www.goodsync.com/license): GoodSync end-user license terms.
